text:
Goal
make the user lookup idempotent and cache safe
Context
concurrent requests currently hit the database simultaneously causing pool exhaustion
Constraints
do not modify database schema
cache ttl must not exceed sixty seconds
Done
load test shows zero pool exhaustion under five hundred concurrent requests

Goal
refactor the payment refund handler to use atomic transactions
Context
partial refund failures leave order records in inconsistent state
Constraints
never modify external gateway contracts
do not log credit card numbers or credentials
Done
integration tests pass ten times consecutively with simulated gateway errors

Goal
implement backpressure in the event stream consumer
Context
heavy burst ingestion crashes workers with out of memory errors
Constraints
do not drop unacknowledged messages
never block the main event loop thread
Done
consumer runs without memory growth during thirty minute soak test

Goal
add tenant isolation to the product catalog queries
Context
multi tenant deployment must prevent cross tenant data leakage
Constraints
never bypass tenant id filtering in query builder
do not rely on application layer memory filtering
Done
test suite asserts cross tenant access attempts return empty results

Goal
optimize the search autocomplete endpoint latency
Context
p99 latency currently exceeds two hundred milliseconds on mobile
Constraints
do not introduce external search infrastructure
never allocate fresh buffers on the hot request path
Done
benchmark report confirms p99 latency below twenty five milliseconds

Goal
replace synchronous file writes with non blocking append stream
Context
request threads block during disk io spikes under high concurrency
Constraints
must not drop log lines on process termination
never block request worker threads with synchronous calls
Done
throughput benchmark shows zero blocked worker threads under load

Goal
isolate the memory leak in the websocket session registry
Context
heap snapshot shows accumulating disconnect listeners over time
Constraints
do not disable existing client heartbeat timeouts
never retain closed socket references in maps
Done
continuous test shows flat heap memory usage after ten thousand disconnects

Goal
harden the password reset token verification workflow
Context
timing variations in token string comparison leak valid prefixes
Constraints
do not use standard equality operators for hash comparison
never return distinct error messages for invalid or expired tokens
Done
timing attack benchmark shows zero statistically significant delta

Goal
implement distributed rate limiting on the public authentication api
Context
credential stuffing bots exceed single node memory counters
Constraints
do not store token buckets in local process memory
must not block benign traffic during redis failover
Done
automated load test asserts four hundred twenty nine on sixty first attempt

Goal
migrate the orders table to use bigint primary keys safely
Context
integer sequence will overflow within thirty days at current volume
Constraints
zero downtime during column expansion
do not acquire table locks lasting longer than fifty milliseconds
Done
migration runner completes in staging with zero rejected write queries

Goal
decouple the notification dispatcher from the checkout transaction
Context
slow third party sms gateway calls increase database transaction duration
Constraints
never execute external network requests inside database transactions
do not lose pending notifications on unexpected worker restarts
Done
checkout endpoint latency drops below eighty milliseconds under load

Goal
enforce strict validation schemas on incoming partner webhooks
Context
malformed payload shapes occasionally trigger unhandled exceptions
Constraints
do not parse payloads without schema verification
never expose internal stack traces in webhook error responses
Done
fuzzing test suite with one thousand malformed payloads passes with zero unhandled errors

Goal
resolve the deadlock between inventory reservation and order placement
Context
concurrent transactions acquire lock keys in alternating sequences
Constraints
do not disable serializable transaction isolation
never acquire inventory locks without lexicographical key ordering
Done
concurrency harness runs fifty parallel checkout tasks with zero deadlocks

Goal
implement circuit breaking for downstream currency conversion calls
Context
third party exchange rate service outages cause cascading thread exhaustion
Constraints
do not leave circuits open indefinitely without health probe attempts
never throw unhandled exceptions to storefront clients
Done
service returns cached fallback exchange rates during simulated outage

Goal
stream large audit export files directly to cloud storage
Context
generating annual compliance archives triggers out of memory process exits
Constraints
must not buffer entire export payload in memory
do not block the http worker during file upload
Done
export test creates five gigabyte archive with process memory capped under eighty megabytes

Goal
implement graceful shutdown for the distributed queue worker
Context
deployments terminate pods abruptly leaving tasks in partially processed states
Constraints
do not accept new tasks after shutdown signal is received
never kill active worker threads before thirty second grace period
Done
sigterm integration test verifies all in flight jobs complete before process exit

Goal
eliminate the n plus one query pattern in the user activity feed
Context
fetching feed items triggers individual database queries for each author profile
Constraints
do not use client side joins in application memory
never execute database queries inside loop iterations
Done
query logger confirms exactly two sql queries executed for fifty feed items

Goal
add cryptographically secure signature verification to file downloads
Context
asset download urls can be tampered with to access unauthorized customer documents
Constraints
do not allow expired signature timestamps to succeed
never hardcode signing keys or secrets in source files
Done
security test suite verifies expired or altered urls return four hundred three

Goal
implement read your own writes consistency across database replicas
Context
users update profiles but immediately see stale values from replica reads
Constraints
do not route all read traffic to the primary database
never cache authorization state across user boundaries
Done
end to end test verifies immediate profile edit reflection with zero delay

Goal
isolate thread safety violations in the in memory metric aggregator
Context
concurrent metric increment operations produce inconsistent counter sums under high load
Constraints
do not use heavy global mutex locks across the entire registry
never allow unsynchronized read write access to shared counters
Done
benchmark confirms counter integrity across one million concurrent increments
